entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker who has claimed dominion over Ravnica and is close to completing the Elderspell.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker group, led by Chandra Nalaar, Jace Beleren and Gideon Jura, that fights Bolas.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who leads the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who leads the Gatewatch and a main protagonist of the story.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker and one of the two main protagonists of the story.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker and secondary antagonist of the story.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane over which Bolas has claimed dominion and where the war is fought.

entities.name: Elderspell
entities.description: The spell that harvests sparks and would grant Bolas ultimate power and godhood.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The all-out planeswalker war against Bolas on Ravnica.

events.summary: The fight between the Gatewatch and Nicol Bolas turns into an all-out planeswalker war on Ravnica as dozens of planeswalkers unite against the elder dragon.
events.quote: The fight turns into an all-out Planeswalker war .

events.summary: Bolas nears completing the Elderspell that harvests sparks and would grant him godhood.
events.quote: is perilously close to completing the Elderspell that harvests sparks

events.summary: The planeswalkers fight alongside the Gatewatch against Bolas and his Eternals, unaware that Bolas is relying on their interference.
events.quote: Little do the Gatewatch suspect that Bolas has not only accounted for their interference, but he is practically relying on it.
